CREATE UNIQUE INDEX optimizer_runs_pkey ON public.optimizer_runs USING btree (id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX previous_shift_snapshots_pkey ON public.previous_shift_snapshots USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profiles_auth_user_id_key ON public.profiles USING btree (auth_user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profiles_pkey ON public.profiles USING btree (id)

name: public.shift_nurse_invites.Charge nurses can create invites for

metadata.policyname: Charge nurses can create invites for their own active shifts
metadata.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (active_shifts
     JOIN profiles ON ((profiles.id = active_shifts.charge_profile_id)))
  WHERE ((active_shifts.id = shift_nurse_invites.shift_id) AND (active_shifts.ended_at IS NULL) AND (profiles.id = shift_nurse_invites.created_by_profile_id) AND (profiles.auth_user_id = auth.uid()) AND (profiles.role = 'charge_nurse'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE((active_shifts.shift_snapshot -> 'nurses'::text), '[]'::jsonb)) nurse(value)
          WHERE ((nurse.value ->> 'id'::text) = shift_nurse_invites.nurse_id))))))
